patterns.name: conn_query_row_scalar
patterns.notes: Single-row read with typed params. Use the trait's ToSqlValue path.

patterns.name: conn_query_map
patterns.notes: Multi-row read returning Vec<Vec<String>>; typed cells via storage_backend_cells.

patterns.name: conn_execute_batch
patterns.notes: Raw Connection DDL / multi-statement execution. Trait method already covers this.

patterns.name: conn_execute
patterns.notes: Single-statement execute with typed params. Helper wraps the trait.

patterns.name: conn_prepare_cached
patterns.notes: Bulk-execute pattern (prepare_cached + loop execute). Migrate to StorageBackend::execute_many (ft-qgj81 slice 5).

patterns.name: conn_prepare
patterns.notes: prepare followed by query_row/query_map: migrate to query_row_typed/query_map_typed. prepare followed by loop execute: migrate to execute_many. See the prepare/prepare_cached recipe in the migration guide.

patterns.name: conn_pragma_query
patterns.notes: Single PRAGMA reads — helper wraps query_row_typed with the PRAGMA-name guard.

patterns.name: conn_transaction
patterns.notes: Transaction lifecycle is on the trait but the call-site borrowing pattern (TX as type) needs a follow-on closure-based helper.

patterns.name: rusqlite_params_macro
patterns.notes: Parameter binding via ToSqlValue — convert each param at call time.

patterns.name: rusqlite_optional
patterns.notes: rusqlite's ::optional() chains — replace with the trait's Option<...> return.

patterns.name: row_get_typed
patterns.notes: Per-column typed reads inside a query_map closure — RowReader bundles them.

patterns.name: row_get_index
patterns.notes: Indexed row reads — RowReader's i64/text/blob accessors mirror this.

patterns.name: rusqlite_connection_open
patterns.notes: Direct Connection::open construction — replace with RusqliteBackend::open.

patterns.name: to_sql_call
patterns.notes: Manual rusqlite::ToSql conversions — ToSqlValue's From impls cover the scalar cases.
